capabilities: Render Bases databases as a Notion-style table with colored pills and hover-reveal OPEN buttons
Edit cells inline with a pill select menu, calendar date editor, and in-place checkboxes
Open and edit notes in a centered Notion-style page panel with editable title and properties
Assign custom colors to pill values via a per-value color picker or pinned colors
Sort from column headers and compute per-column calculations like sum, average, and counts
extras: Requires Obsidian 1.10.2+ with the Bases core plugin enabled. Ships an optional Notion-style toolbar as a separate CSS snippet. Includes a disclaimer that it is not affiliated with Notion Labs, Inc. Only note.* frontmatter properties are editable; file.* and formula.* columns are read-only.
intentEvidence: A custom Bases view for Obsidian that renders your databases as a Notion-style table
problem: Obsidian's built-in Bases table view has plain chrome, no hover-open affordance, and limited inline editing, so databases don't look or behave like Notion's.

relations.evidence: A Bases table view styled to match Notion databases: hover UI, OPEN buttons

summary: A custom Bases view that renders databases as a Notion-style table with colored pills, inline cell editing, a hover OPEN button, and a page panel.
